title: TestProxyChainingSSLReconnect randomly fails
body:
TestProxyChainingSSLReconnect seems to contain a difficult-to-trigger race condition, only surfacing every 100th run or so. This is possibly related to https://github.com/mitmproxy/netlib/commit/e6a8730f98d61583f31ac530e2a1c8da2fa181ed - can .recv() trigger an SSL error in rare cases?
